items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever make any records with Kid Schatz or Ricard Alexis? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, that was Papa Celestine.

ctx.x: Second trumpet at that time. Let me see. With Papa Celestine was the second trumpet. I know it wasn't Guy because Guy wasn't, Guy hadn't come to New Orleans yet. How was Sniety? Sniety. Sniety.
Have a Sniety. Did you ever make any records with Kid Schatz or Ricard Alexis? Ricard Alexis? Was he on any of those?
Oh, that was Papa Celestine. We recorded for A La Bar and Maryland and High Society. The real old ones. I mean the real old band though in the 1920s.
